overview.title: Overview
overview.notDetectedHint: Install DeepSeek Harness (npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh) or add it to PATH.
overview.openHarnessHint: Opens the AI console in your browser.
overview.runDoctorEmpty: Run Doctor to diagnose the environment.
overview.runtimeError: The DeepSeek Harness CLI was not found.
overview.installUpdateHint: Downloads the release bundle, verifies its checksum and opens the installer.
overview.noScenarios: No scenarios yet. Start one after creating it.
overview.taskHint: Task scenario: starts when a task runs

doctor.engineDesc: DeepMate needs DeepSeek Harness to work.
doctor.consoleDesc: Start it to open the management UI in your browser.
doctor.bundlesOk: Plugin declarations all match the installed set
doctor.bundlesMissing: Some declared plugins are not installed
doctor.bundlesMissingDesc: The console tries to load these plugins on every start, and a missing one fails the whole plugin set with a load error. Reinstall the plugin, or clear the stale declaration.
doctor.bundlesAction: Reinstall from the Plugins page, or remove the stale entry
doctor.bundlesLoadOk: Installed plugins load correctly in the console
doctor.bundlesLoadFailed: Some plugins fail to load in the console
doctor.bundlesLoadFailedDesc: The console cannot serve these plugins' client bundle, so loading them in the browser reports an error. Update or reinstall the plugin to restore it.
doctor.bundlesLoadAction: Update or reinstall the plugin from the Plugins page
doctor.uiUrlInvalid: The web UI address is invalid
doctor.uiUrlInvalidDesc: The configured web UI address cannot be parsed, so the status checks would be misleading. Remove the custom address to restore the default.
doctor.uiReachSkippedDesc: Skipped while the harness CLI is missing or the web UI address is not usable.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.searchEmpty: Search the market to discover plugins.
plugins.marketEmpty: The curated list is empty. Search the market to discover plugins.
plugins.removeConfirmBody: This uninstalls "{{name}}" from the scenario. This cannot be undone.
plugins.forgetConfirmBody: This removes "{{name}}" from the disabled list. The plugin is already uninstalled, so nothing else changes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet. Export your current setup to make it portable.
settings.deleteSnapshotConfirmBody: This permanently removes the snapshot "{{name}}". This cannot be undone.
settings.importSnapshotConfirmBody: This overwrites the current scenarios, providers and models with the snapshot "{{name}}".
settings.importConfigConfirmBody: This overwrites the current DeepMate preferences with the imported file.
settings.apiKeyHint: DeepMate never stores the key itself; enter the name of the environment variable that holds it.
settings.restartToApply: Plugin changes take effect after the scenario restarts.
settings.surfaceWebHint: Opens the AI console in your browser.
settings.surfaceTaskHint: Run a one-shot task and read its result.

errors.incompatible: This plugin is not compatible with the installed harness.
errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.
errors.network: A network error occurred. Check your connection and try again.
errors.permission: Permission denied. Check the file or system permissions.
errors.checksum: The downloaded file failed its checksum verification.
errors.crash: The interface hit an unexpected error.
